summary: Backend-only review of PerksLocks Odds API circuit breaker hardening + admin diagnostic endpoints + auto-relax floor logic. Created /app/backend/tests/test_perkslocks_circuit_breaker_review.py with 26 tests across 8 test classes covering auth gating, JSON shape, circuit reset, force-refresh, HEAL PICKS NOW, /api/version DATA_VERSION, auto-relax behavior, and regression on existing picks endpoints. ALL 26 TESTS PASSED. Verified diagnostic on local backend shows healthy state (has_key=true, key_tail='...6e5c', total_ok=66, total_fail=0, disabled=false, 265 picks today, 221 high-lock). DATA_VERSION returns the expected '2026.06.26-auto-relax-thin-slate'. Auto-relax does NOT fire with current healthy slate (221 high-lock >> 8 cutoff). All new admin endpoints correctly enforce auth gating (401 unauth, 403 non-admin). Demo login + pick detail enrichment + /api/picks/all + /api/picks/under-of-the-day + /api/picks/rollover all 200. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints in /app/backend/routes/admin_routes.py (odds-diagnostic, odds-circuit/reset, force-refresh, picks/heal) correctly depend on current_admin -> require_admin_user which 401s on missing token and 403s on non-admin role.

sports_engine.get_odds_api_status returns the exact shape the diagnostic endpoint promises in its docstring (has_key, key_tail, disabled, disabled_reason, consecutive_401s, consecutive_failures, total_ok, total_fail, last_error).

Auto-relax block in server.py (~L2082-2140) is correctly guarded by `min_lock is None and market is None and league is None and not day_offset and not grade and lt != 'alt'`, so explicit user overrides bypass relaxation as required.
force-refresh and picks/heal both reset the circuit breaker before queuing _refresh_picks, which matches the documented operator flow.
Latest picks sample correctly excludes mongo _id via projection {_id:0,...}; JSON-safe.

Production 1-pick incident was resolved by user rotating their Odds API key in production secrets; the new circuit-breaker reset + HEAL PICKS NOW button + auto-relax safety net all behave as designed when probed against the local healthy environment.
